crime_description: Swapping a valuable collection of rare coins with clever counterfeits. Interrogators should probe for connections to an inside coin dealer, financial motives, and offshore accounts.

suspect.name: Mia Ruiz
suspect.fake_alibi: Mia claims she was attending a numismatic convention.

secrets.value: A coin dealer who provided Mia with the high-quality counterfeits.
Mia needs the money to save her family's failing business.
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
